code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, mild anemia with low MCHC, elevated ferritin, CRP, and INR, and mildly increased creatinine. These findings suggest significant systemic inflammation, possible infection or sepsis, and impaired oxygenation. The hematologic abnormalities may indicate bone marrow suppression or consumption. Immediate clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
